Posted 'Tatooine Desert Heart', 'Prepared Defense', 'There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement' and 'Power Of The Hutt' dested the printed cards (Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck / Death Star II / Reflections II), not the later virtual versions.

Posted 'No Bargin' dested No Bargain; 'Maul's Lightsiber' Maul's Lightsaber; 'Disarmed' the Dark Effect Disarmed (Dark); 'Secret Plans' the Special Edition Effect Secret Plans (posted among the Effects; the Defensive Shield Secret Plans is a Reflections III card and the deck is built without Reflections III).

The strategy's 'Deck Edit' suggests swapping Jabba The Hutt for Mighty Jabba, Imperial Arrest Order and Secret Plans for the combo plus Zuckuss In Mist Hunter, and Hutt Smooch for the posted 'Hutt Smooch / Defensive Fire Combo'; the list is kept as posted. Security Precautions is named as an optional 61st card and is not listed.
